desktop.comparison_scope: All returned audio compared, including source output not ultimately presented because of latency tails. Delivered counters are separate. Complete comparison coverage here includes every delivered sample; idle valid silence and priming do not establish audible program duration.
desktop.underflow_request_trace: No ordinary underrun in this run; no fault-specific desktop delay to diagnose. Injected local request traces retained above.

retained_unaffected: Original AP4/D9, AP5, AP6 and AP7 evidence unchanged. Prior real save/reopen/recovery results retain their source, not relabelled as this build.
limits: Explicit counted gaps remain possible when valid output is late; queue capacity, disconnect, request timeout and corrupt output remain terminal.
No claim that an unreproduced AP5/AP6/AP7 historical transport/timing event shares a root cause.
Observer overflow discards optional observations, invalidates its reference until actual state readback, and never counts unchecked samples as verified.
First 32 missing-span request traces retained, with trace overflow reported. Trace stages are native elapsed intervals, not separate proof of Windows CPU time.
This is bounded two-instance AGain evidence, not long-run reliability, commercial plug-in qualification or physical acoustic listening proof.
test_only_followup: Actual mapped/TCP worker exercised with paused observer and reader; the only release-source edit removes a redundant immediately called closure around activation.
